> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **11** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 27a8b33dec2eb98b73b3e5146e740067cdbd7806` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c6394f1198c4640659d23357d8a964c16b6770c6` — the merge of head `09eff738144880b71352856df824fadb99af46ee` into base `27a8b33dec2eb98b73b3e5146e740067cdbd7806`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c6394f1198c4640659d23357d8a964c16b6770c6 && git checkout c6394f1198c4640659d23357d8a964c16b6770c6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 27a8b33dec2eb98b73b3e5146e740067cdbd7806 09eff738144880b71352856df824fadb99af46ee && git checkout -B drift-repro 27a8b33dec2eb98b73b3e5146e740067cdbd7806 && git merge --no-ff 09eff738144880b71352856df824fadb99af46ee

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 27a8b33dec2eb98b73b3e5146e740067cdbd7806
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 27a8b33dec2eb98b73b3e5146e740067cdbd7806` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `49f00d1b396d5f507432e19a6bcf983b194296d3`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #15206 body and all 20 comments (the stage plan 6067844889, triage 6068032120, the S2 note 6071504870, the retriage 6073429093 and its answer 6073941543, both os-dev-reports 6073375433 and 6074422275); ADR-0131 D2/D6, ADR-0126 §3, ADR-0029 D9.6/D9.7, ADR-0086 D1 and #6960 on `main`; the cross-lane declarations #6021 6073437063, #6024 6074389847, #6023 6071511369 and the #22400 note 6074377711; PR #22401's body, its 32-file list (identical to `git diff --name-only origin/main...head`) and the net diff; the head's check-runs. The merge-base with `main` (`abd254508b`) is `11d119ab18`; `git merge-tree` of the head against `origin/main` and against #22416's head `d8eee2191a` both exit 0 (a read of git objects, no worktree). PR #22416 is still open, not merged.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set changes the diff implies, each judged on the code at the head:

- **Save door** (`refusePackagedBaseOverride`, protocol.ts:17239): predicate is `isSealedManagedItem = isArtifactBacked && !registryAllowsOverlay`; `registryAllowsOverlay` reads `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES` only, never `envWritableTypes()`. A hatch-open overlay of an artifact-backed item of a non-overlay type moves admitted → `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. **Right** (ADR-0131 D6 regime C). The named-base limb keeps `ITEM_LOCKED`. **Right.**
- **Removal door** (`refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, :17342): same predicate, `&& !mergesOverlayAtRead(type)`. Hatch-open removal of a managed flow/object/action/hook row moves admitted → 403. **Right.** The #6960 carve-out (`OVERLAY_CAPABLE_TYPES` = `supportsOverlay`) is untouched, so a stored row of `permission`, `position`, `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `book`, `tool`, `skill` still removes and restores the package definition. **Right, and pinned** (dogfood `control (#6960)`, `packaged-base-refusal` `page` delete → null).
- **Read envelope** (`servedLockState`, :16828) asks both doors through `packagedBaseRefusal`; `editable`/`deletable` read false for a managed item with the hatch open under both spellings. **Right, pinned** in the runtime file ×4.
- **Repository** (`assertAllowed`, sys-metadata-repository.ts:1784): the hatch limb is now `if (hatchOpen && intent === 'runtime-only') return;`, and `override-artifact` falls through to `managedItemSealedSentence`. `put` (:730), `promoteDraft` (:1146) and `restoreVersion` (:1275) all reach it with `opts.intent`; the protocol computes that intent from `isArtifactBacked` at protocol.ts:21025 (save), :22519 (publish), :25661 (revertCommit) and :26205 (rollback). So draft promotion, restore and revert are sealed one layer down. **Right.** `assertDeleteAllowed` (:2046) keeps the `supportsOverlay` and origin-gated carve-outs and seals the rest. **Right.**
- **`saveMetaItem` code-only check** (:20450): for a shipped item it reads `registryAllowsOverlay` alone; for an item no package ships it still reads `isOverlayAllowed` (hatch included), so runtime creation of a hatch-named type stays open (M6; triage 6073941543: by design). **Right.**
- **`deleteMetaItem` route** (:26800): for an artifact-backed item the repository-vs-raw route ignores the hatch. On an environment kernel the removal door (:26744) answers first, so `?dropStorage=true` never reaches `shouldDropStorage` (:26916 / :27086). **Right, pinned** (dogfood: 403, data plane up).
- **`/automation` doors** (runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:1500-1510): `PUT /:name` and `DELETE /:name` ask `packagedBaseRefusal`; `POST /` and the clone write go through `tenantAuthoredWriteRefusal`, which asks the same door. The toggle writes the activation ledger, not `sys_metadata`. **Right, pinned** (`automation-packaged-base-lock` hatch-open case now asserts PUT and DELETE 403 and toggle 200).
- **Sentences**: `codeOnlyOverrideError`, `readOnlyBaseOverrideError` and the repository's type door no longer prescribe the hatch; codes and statuses unchanged. **Right.** The `NOT_CREATABLE` sentence for a `runtime-only` write still names the hatch, which is the one door that opens that write. **Right.**
- **Public surface** (`Clause-②: no`): `readOnlyBaseOverrideError(type, packageId)` loses its optional third parameter — a narrowing; `git grep` at the head finds callers only in protocol.ts:17301, sys-metadata-repository.ts:1826 and in-package tests. **Right.** `registryAllowsOverlay` and `isSealedManagedItem` are private. `managedItemSealedSentence` is exported from its module but `src/index.ts` exports nothing from `packaged-base-regime` and `package.json` exposes only `.`. **Nothing widens. Right.**

Paths that write `sys_metadata` for an artifact-backed name, each read at the head: save (both kernels), draft save, publish/promote, restore, revert/rollback, delete (both routes), `/automation` PUT/POST/DELETE/clone, `migrateStoredMetadata` (:21716, writes through the sealed path and now records `failed` on a stranded row rather than rewriting it), plugin-security `permission-set-overlay-discard.ts:258` (deletes a permission-set overlay row directly: the merge-at-read removal #6960 keeps, not a seal miss). **No door edits or removes a managed item of a non-overlay type under either spelling.** Two notes, neither a miss introduced here: (a) the host-config kernel's raw-engine repair (:27081) still deletes a stored residue row of a code-only type (`job`, `field`, `capability`) — pre-existing, hatch-independent, removes residue and leaves the code definition standing; (b) the repository trusts the caller's intent, so a direct `getOverlayRepo().put(..., intent: 'runtime-only')` on a managed name lands a row (the dogfood file seeds its legacy rows exactly so) — no production caller outside protocol.ts, pre-existing.

What must stay open — each kept and pinned, none sealed by accident: regime O (`view` overlay PUT/DELETE 200: dogfood, runtime ×4, `packaged-base-refusal`); the #6960 removal for permission sets and positions (dogfood 200, rows gone); toggle (dogfood 200 under `single`; the operator wall's 46 pins untouched); linkage-free clone (dogfood); a new flow through `/meta` and `POST /automation` (dogfood, runtime ×4); a new item of a hatch-named type (`package-writability` control: `job` runtime-only lands a row).

The removal door and the stranded rows: at base, hatch open, `DELETE` over a legacy overlay row of a managed flow or object reset it; at head it answers 403 and the row stays, as pinned. Triage's Q1 → C (6073941543) sends those rows to S5 (reported at boot, not served) and their migration fate to C7. The PR body, the changeset ("keeps serving, and can no longer be edited or removed through the metadata API, with the hatch set or not") and `environment-variables.mdx` ("Overlay rows this hatch wrote before are still served") are truthful at this head; no sentence promises a remedy that does not exist.

Re-premised pins, spot-checked (10 files + the showcase file): `protocol.packaged-base-refusal` (hatch case → a 2×2 matrix of spelling × kernel comparing hatch-open to hatch-shut byte for byte, plus `page` delete and `view` save still null), `sys-metadata-repository.package-writability` (NARROW's three preservation pins flipped to refused on both kernels, the legacy spelling added, a `job` runtime-only control added), `protocol.legacy-overlay-delete`, `protocol.tenant-authored-write`, `protocol.delete-receipt-wording`; objectql `protocol-object-overlay-layer` (the D9.7 subtraction under the hatch → refused, layer and data plane kept; the plural spelling folded into the same case), `protocol-destructive` (specimen moved to a tenant-authored object, the detector's remaining population), `protocol-meta` (specimen moved to a regime-O view); rest `meta-object-owd-gate` (tighten and both widen cases → 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE, `declaredCode` undefined), `rest-meta-packaged-flow-refusal`; runtime `automation-packaged-base-lock`, `meta-overlay-read-your-writes`; dogfood `showcase-object-extension-scalar-divergence` (the rename seeded as a pre-seal row + cold boot, so both read cases keep a premise; the round-trip pinned refused). No subject weakened, skipped or deleted; the two owd-gate R1 cases are kept as refused-before-R1 pins rather than deleted. The plugin-security lock-gate file: its two hatch-OPEN cases now assert exactly what its hatch-CLOSED case asserts (not the lock's class, 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE, no row) — the same subject, the layer identity pinned as moved; the lock itself stays positively pinned in `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts:1049/1070/1105`. #22365's cold-boot control still tests its subject (rows under built-in position names, restart boots, stored definition answers) with the seal's 403 pinned first; `SYS` is defined at line 55; its hunks (34-42, 115-125, 204-229) are adjacent to, not the same lines as, #22416's (38-57, 104-131), and `merge-tree` is clean.

Reverse verification: the two mutations (protocol `registryAllowsOverlay` also reading `envWritableTypes()`; repository `if (hatchOpen) return;`) reopen exactly the cases that assert the hatch-open 403s. The reported partitions match the code: rest 6/6 fail (4 PUT + 2 DELETE); runtime 8 fail / 4 pass (the 4 controls); dogfood 4 fail / 6 pass (premise, #6960, view, new flow, toggle, clone). New pins are not vacuous: every refusal case asserts status, code and no row, and the controls assert a row landed.

Findings, note only: the legacy-spelling reader divergence is its own card (triage); the hatch's runtime creation of `allowRuntimeCreate: false` types is by design (triage).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/15206-managed-content-sealed.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `minor`, `feat(...)!:`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The level matches what the diff publishes: source changes are confined to three `metadata-protocol` files; `objectql` (5), `rest` (3 + 1 new), `runtime` (2 + 1 new), `plugin-security` (1) and dogfood (3) change tests only, and `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` is tooling, so no other package owes a changeset. `(narrowing)` is BREAKING per AGENTS.md, and BREAKING on the v18 line is graded `minor` because `.changeset/pre.json` is `{mode: pre, tag: next}` and `22080-v18-line-opens.md` already majors the fixed group that holds both `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`.changeset/config.json` fixed[0]) — the same shape S1's changeset took. Every sentence about pre mode is true. The PR's `Clause-②: no` line agrees with the changeset's arm, which is where the gate reads it. The ADR-0087 disposition is honest: no spec key, stored shape or export moves, every stored row loads unchanged, and the stranded rows are S5's reported population and C7's migration fate by triage's ruling, so this change prescribes no migration. The merge-at-read list in the changeset (`permission`, `position`, `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `book`, `tool`, `skill`) is exactly the registry's `supportsOverlay: true, allowOrgOverride: false` set. The `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` row in `environment-variables.mdx` is true at this head: the hatch opens runtime creation and the org-scoped write (`orgScopedWriteRefusal` still reads `isOverlayAllowed`) for items no package ships, and nothing on a managed item.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev Q1 (stranded rows): answered by triage, C (6073941543); recorded in the body; nothing changes here. Answered.
- Dev Q2 (`/meta/types` flag): answered A; the carrier is #22340. Answered.
- Dev Q3 (the plugin-security test): A — declared on #6021 (6073437063), applied in patch round 1; no objection on #15206. Answered.
- Dogfood files declared on #6024 (6074389847); `environment-variables.mdx` on #6023 (6071511369); the cold-boot file coordinated on #22400 (6074377711), #22416 lands first and the merge is clean. Answered.
- ADR-0029 D9.6 and ADR-0086 D1 text still describe the hatch as a door: Tier H, routed by triage to S2 or S7 as the seat plans; the plan carries S7. Escalated.
- Stale comments and the studio checklist note: noted by the dev, carriers named. Note only.
- **Docs — one published sentence this PR makes false, and does not fix.** `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx:480-486` says: "An environment overlay of a packaged object may only tighten `sharingModel` / `externalSharingModel`, never widen them beyond the packaged declaration (`403 owd_widening_forbidden` — … this closes the `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=object` escape hatch as an unvalidated widening path, ADR-0086 D1)." At base that was true on the hatch path it names: a tightening overlay landed (200) and a widening one answered `owd_widening_forbidden`. At this head an environment overlay of a packaged object is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` in both directions, hatch open or shut — this PR's own `packages/rest/src/meta-object-owd-gate.test.ts` re-premises exactly those three cases ("TIGHTENS a packaged object is sealed too", "refused by the package door before R1, `declaredCode` undefined"). The sentence now claims an accepted write that is refused and names a refusal code a caller can no longer receive. That is false, not stale, and it must be rewritten in this PR (the path is `domain:docs`; declare it on #6023 as `environment-variables.mdx` was). The other pages the dev lists are stale context, not false: `permission-sets.mdx:363-370` describes the origin and remedy of an existing row, and the Discard Overlay action exists; `adding-a-metadata-type.mdx:59-63` describes the type-level flag the listing still flips; `studio-authoring.json:542/609` is a dated run record; `capabilities.mdx:225` and `declarative-endpoints.mdx:291` describe runtime-only creation the hatch still opens.
- CI, read once at 2026-10-09T04:57Z on this head: 41 check-runs, 36 success, 4 skipped (`Auto Label`, `Check PR Size`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` — none required), 1 in progress. Required contexts: `TypeScript Type Check`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` all success; `Test Core` is still running — shard `Test Core (1/6)` in progress, shards 2/6–6/6 success, the aggregate not yet reported. A red on `Test Core` is this PR's own. `Lint & Repo Gates` is green, so the known `main` red (#22400, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`, the `mkdtempSync` base fixed by #22416) is not red on this head.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `09eff738144880b71352856df824fadb99af46ee`
Local-runs: none

Re-review after the FAIL on `49f00d1b39` (6074635359). Inputs read on top of that review's: the patch-round-2 os-dev-report 6074930749, the amended #6023 declaration 6074649945, the rewritten PR body, the net diff `49f00d1b39..09eff73814`, and this head's check-runs. The card has no objection since the last review (only a claim release, a new claim and the dev report). `main` is at `27a8b33dec`, which is #22416's squash-merge commit; `git merge-tree` of this head against it exits 0 (a read of git objects, no worktree). The merge-base is unchanged, `11d119ab18`.

### ① Derived judgments

`git diff --stat 49f00d1b39..09eff73814`: one file, `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`, +7 −5, all inside the "Runtime OWD posture gate" bullet; one commit, `docs(permissions): …`. `protocol.ts`, the repository, the regime module, every test and the changeset are byte-identical to the reviewed head, so every ① judgment of 6074635359 stands as written: the one predicate at the save door, the removal door and the read envelope; the repository's `runtime-only`-only hatch limb reached by put, promoteDraft and restoreVersion with the protocol's `isArtifactBacked` intent; the hatch-independent code-only check and delete route for shipped items; the `/automation` doors; the kept regime-O overlay, #6960 removal, toggle, linkage-free clone, new flow and new hatch-named item; the narrowed `readOnlyBaseOverrideError` with no out-of-package caller; nothing widening.

The rewritten bullet, judged sentence by sentence against this head:

- "An environment overlay of a packaged object is refused outright, whether it tightens or widens `sharingModel` / `externalSharingModel`, and with `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` set or not (`403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` — managed content is sealed, ADR-0131 D6)". **True.** `saveMetaItem` calls `refusePackagedBaseOverride` at protocol.ts:20389, whose predicate `isSealedManagedItem` reads the registry alone, and `object` declares `allowOrgOverride: false`; `packages/rest/src/meta-object-owd-gate.test.ts` pins the tightening overlay (`private`/`private` over `public_read`/`private`), both widening overlays and the lint-plus-R1 body, each `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with `declaredCode` undefined and no row, with `envWritableObject: true`. With the hatch shut the same door already answered at base.
- "change the posture in the package source and publish instead". **True as a route**: the package author's change, the one the page already names for packaged permission sets; the sentence claims no runtime route, and an object has none (regime E extends, it does not re-posture).
- "The package door answers ahead of this gate, so its packaged-baseline rule (`403 owd_widening_forbidden`, ADR-0086 D1) is not reached through the metadata API." **True.** `runAuthoringGate` has one call site, protocol.ts:20960, inside `saveMetaItem`, after the package door at :20389 and after the lint table (`INVALID_METADATA` at :20593 / :20796); the package door is asked on both kernel shapes (pinned on the host-config topology in `sys-metadata-repository.package-writability.test.ts` and the plugin-security lock-gate file, and on the environment kernel in the REST file). A body with a packaged baseline is by definition artifact-backed, so it meets the door first; `owd_widening_forbidden` (`object-posture-gate.ts:132`) is unreachable through `/meta`. The test file's "door ORDER" case pins exactly this.
- The retained sentences — the gate is registered on the `registerAuthoringGate` seam and runs on runtime-authored object bodies; write-path only, stored metadata loads unchanged; R2 retired, the 422 lint door answers first for external-wider and unauthored-OWD bodies, and "the 403 gate remains for packaged-baseline widening only" — describe the gate's registration and scope, which the new sentence then says is not reached; for a non-packaged body the lint-before-gate order still holds. **Not false.**

Nothing else on the page moved (the diff is the bullet alone), and the page's only other mentions of the hatch, `owd_widening_forbidden` or `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` are the bullet's own (lines 481–487). The pages judged stale in 6074635359 are unchanged and still stale-not-false; `environment-variables.mdx` is unchanged and still true.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged and right: `.changeset/15206-managed-content-sealed.md`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `minor` with the BREAKING paragraph, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in pre mode (`pre.json` `{mode: pre, tag: next}`) on the fixed group `22080-v18-line-opens.md` already majors. The round-2 commit is a docs page only, which publishes nothing from any package, so it owes no changeset and changes no level; the PR's `Clause-②: no` line still agrees with the changeset's arm.
